name: Gigabeef's "Tarkov Movie" soundtrack replacer
teaser: Replaces the default menu music with most of Gigabeef's custom tracks that are used by many Tarkov influencers in their longform content. Chill vibes to work through your crafting and task lists.
description_html:
Ever found yourself watching one of the many tarkov movies on youtube, enjoying the chill background music as you watch you favorite youtuber or streamer go through their quests, only to load up SPT and find yourself bashed over the head with the same handful of EFT songs? Well, now you can work through your hideout, modify weapon loadouts, and peruse traders to the same relaxing playlist provided by Gigabeef for free.

Installation: Drop the “CustomMusic” folder into your BepInEx/Plugins folder and enjoy.

Should be compatible with all of Junko Space Mommy’s Music packs.
